test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A 234 m long train passes a person running at 9 km/h in the opposite direction, in 6 seconds. In how much time (in seconds) will it pass another person who is moving at 23.4 km/h, in the same direction?
solution:
**Given:**

A 234 m long train passes a person running at 9 km/h in the opposite direction, in 6 seconds.

**Formula used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of Train + Speed of Person (opposite direction)

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

**Calculations:**

Speed of person = 9 km/h = 9 × (1000/3600) m/s = 2.5 m/s

Let the speed of the train be x m/s

Relative Speed = x + 2.5 m/s

Distance = 234 m

Time = 6 seconds

⇒ 234 = 6 × (x + 2.5)

⇒ 234 = 6x + 15

⇒ 6x = 234 - 15

⇒ 6x = 219

⇒ x = 219 / 6

⇒ x = 36.5 m/s

Speed of the second person = 23.4 km/h = 23.4 × (1000/3600) m/s = 6.5 m/s

Relative Speed = 36.5 - 6.5 m/s

⇒ Relative Speed = 30 m/s

Distance = 234 m

⇒ Time = Distance / Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 234 / 30

⇒ Time = 7.8 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
